cards.name: [Watch Compass] Validate GPS-free web POC v4
cards.description:
Status: Active GPS-free mobile web proof of concept — 12 October 2026.

Current result:
- Private HTTPS PWA deployed at https://watch-compass.fairshark8.chatgpt.site
- Uses device motion, OS-fused orientation, step detection, heading, and pedestrian dead reckoning
- Does not call GPS or the browser geolocation API
- Uses stationary detection and zero-velocity updates to limit short-term drift
- First-use tutorial and three-turn counterclockwise reset are implemented
- Production TypeScript/Vite build passes

Movement model:
1. Set zeros a local east/north/up coordinate frame.
2. Each detected step advances the local position using a 0.72 m step-length estimate and current heading.
3. The return bearing points from the estimated position to the local origin.
4. The blob moves round → teardrop → edge puddle → consolidated bump.

Known constraints:
- Mobile browsers choose sensor frequency; native watch builds can sample faster.
- PDR drifts with variable step length, magnetic interference, and phone-holding angle.
- Field calibration is required separately on iPhone and Android.

Next acceptance:
- Verify step detection while walking normally on iPhone and Android
- Check return direction after straight, L-shaped, and loop routes
- Measure distance error after 10, 25, and 50 steps
- Test near magnetic interference and confirm heading remains stable enough
- Verify offline reopen after first load

Native watchOS and Wear OS experiments remain in native/ for later integration of the same navigation components.

Source: codex://threads/019f5380-5b6e-7a60-b18c-37f63e6808a8
